subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The earthquake had devastated the village beyond imagination.

options.text: The village had devastated by the earthquake beyond imagination.
The village had been devastated beyond imagination by the earthquake.
The village was devastated by the earthquake beyond imagination.
The village has been devastated by the earthquake beyond imagination.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The village had been devastated beyond imagination by the earthquake.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the past perfect tense, indicating an action that happened before another action in the past.
